name: Worldpac Inc
old_description: imports original equipment and automotive replacement parts directly from the most respected manufacturers in the industry. Our complete product offering includes over 110,000 products for over 40 import and domestic vehicle carlines.
about:
Worldpac Inc, headquartered in Woodlawn, Maryland, has been serving professional independent automotive service centers since 1969. The company operates as a wholesale distributor of original equipment (OE) automotive replacement parts, importing directly from manufacturers rather than producing its own components. No founders are named in public records, and ownership details such as family or veteran status are not disclosed.

Worldpac’s catalog encompasses more than 110,000 stocked products (over 120,000 by some counts) covering 41-plus vehicle carlines and 11 million-plus applications. Its proprietary speedDIAL online platform provides real-time availability, pricing, detailed images, and self-service ordering and returns for independent shops. Beyond parts distribution, the company offers carline-specific technical training, business management programs (branded Smart Groups), and turnkey marketing solutions designed to help shop owners focus on operations. Private-label brands include WORLD SOURCEONE AGM batteries, World Brake Resources brake pads, and METRIX climate-control components.

The primary customers are independent automotive repair facilities across North America, ranging from single-bay shops to multi-location operations. Worldpac positions itself as a partner that delivers the same breadth of OE parts and technical support traditionally available only to franchised dealers, enabling independents to service a wide mix of import and domestic vehicles.

Worldpac emphasizes its direct-from-manufacturer sourcing model and the depth of its digital catalog as key differentiators, claiming the largest import and domestic selection in North America and the industry’s most widely used electronic ordering system. The company was founded to give independent service centers dealer-level parts access and operational tools without requiring franchise affiliation.
